verses.text: For the music director. On the eight-stringed lyre. A psalm of David. Help, LORD, because there are no faithful people left. Loyal people have disappeared from among humans.
Everyone lies to their neighbour. They flatter with their lips, but they say one thing and mean another.
May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every tongue that boasts.
They say, "We will win with our tongues. Our lips belong to us. Who can be our master?"
The LORD says, "Because the weak are being crushed and the needy are groaning, I will now get up and act. I will keep them safe from those who attack them."
The LORD's words are pure, like silver that has been melted in a clay furnace and refined seven times.
LORD, you will keep them safe. You will protect them from these people forever.
Wicked people strut around everywhere when what is shameful is praised by people.
